BEJSON 105 Integrity Era Libraries (Libraries_105)

Integrity Era BEJSON 105 / 105a / 105db and MFDB v1.40 library suite featuring mandatory column-0 UUIDv4 record tracking, cross-entity foreign keys, cascade validation, and cryptographic integrity.

Key Capabilities

  • Column-0 UUIDv4 Identity: Every record carries a globally unique identifier and integrity fingerprint.
  • MFDB v1.40 Relational Cascades: Cross-entity foreign-key enforcement and atomic manifest updates.
  • Standardized Entities & AI Core: Unified 16-field registry contracts and zero-SDK multi-provider AI dispatch.
